records.title: MaskMamba: A Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Masked Image Generation
records.reason: MaskMamba targets masked image generation and image quality/speed; it does not study language-model inference or LLM serving.

records.title: CPL: Critical Plan Step Learning Boosts LLM Generalization in Reasoning Tasks
records.reason: CPL is MCTS plus preference training for reasoning/generalization quality; experiments measure task accuracy. Test-time compute and latency are identified as future challenges, not optimized in this work.

records.title: TorchGT: A Holistic System for Large-Scale Graph Transformer Training
records.reason: TorchGT targets topology-aware graph-transformer training. Its methods and measurements concern graph sparsity, partitioning, GPU memory access and per-epoch training time, not LLM generation/serving.

records.title: Wavelet-Based Image Tokenizer for Vision Transformers
records.reason: The wavelet tokenizer maps image pixels to ViT image tokens and evaluates ImageNet training throughput/accuracy; it does not target language models, autoregressive inference or serving latency.

records.title: Bandwidth Characterization of DeepSpeed on Distributed Large Language Model Training
